title: Gift for my best friend
text: Gift for my best friend. It is a very lovely gift it comes in great condition but mine came and it was missing a piece do not feel like dealing with sending it back just going to run out to the store and buy the piece that it was missing to give to my friend don’t have the time to wait for the return😞
